[00:00] Anita Rao: hey everybody thanks for joining, um we'll kick off in a few minutes while folks filter in, appreciate you making time. quick reminder, if you've got que- questions drop them in q&a, we'll do the usual live q and a at the end.

[01:14] Anita Rao: ok, alright good morning, good afternoon wherever you are, excited to share an update on Q1 and look ahead to Q2. big shout out to eng and infra — the Dedicated rollout last month was heavy lift and it's shipping well.

[02:05] Miguel Santos: quick infra note, we've seen median latency for hosted inference drop by about 12% on 8k token flows after the new kernel selector landed, so that's real. there are still a few tail cases with nvlink congestion that we're tracking.

[03:20] Eli Wong: yeah, to add, continuous batching improvements helped throughput on the small prompt users, but some training-like workloads still spike. our autoscaler now has a soft limit to avoid noisy neighbor effect.

[04:05] Priya Kaur: product highlights — we shipped the rerank endpoint beta to 30 customers, and early signals show 18% improvement in retrieval relevance on average for search workloads. note, some customers reported difference in token accounting which we tracked to a tokenizer mismatch in the SDK. fix is out in v0.9.7.

[05:40] Anita Rao: on go-to-market, self-serve growth is healthy — sign-ups up 24% q/q, but ARR motion is slower than we'd like from mid-market. Samir, quick finance?

[06:10] Samir Patel: sure, topline: bookings for Q1 were slightly above target, but revenue recognition lags due to a handful of delayed contracts. burn is roughly in line; runway extends to ~22 months on current plan. priorities are tightening around ARR expansion and larger Dedicated commitments.

[07:30] Anita Rao: thanks. on the enterprise front, security and compliance is a gating factor for a few deals. we have to accelerate SOC 2 re-cert and the ISO cert plan — security, any updates?

[08:05] (unnamed) Security Lead: we're on track for SOC 2 readiness review next month, working with external auditor, a couple of evidence gaps (key rotation logs, expanded RBAC docs) but those are being remediated. also prepping a short whitepaper on Private deployment network diagrams for legal teams.

[09:40] Miguel Santos: technical highlight — KV cache improvements reduced memory blow-up on long convo sessions, but we found a bug where eviction could cause slight correctness issues for some streaming sessions. patch will be in canary tomorrow. note: some transcriptions in the field called it KV 'cash' in tickets which was confusing.

[11:15] Priya Kaur: product roadmap for Q2 — main bets: 1) Dedicated 2.0 (capacity pooling and burst pricing), 2) Private: VPC-first admin UX improvements, 3) Redwood Optimize: automated quantization profiles by workload. expect feature flags and staged rollouts.

[12:45] Eli Wong: engineering capacity — hiring remains top priority, we've filled 8 IC roles this quarter but need to accelerate senior infra hires. we'll open a hiring buffer for critical eng leadership roles.

[14:02] Anita Rao: ok a bit of customer color — demo day last week with a large fintech was promising; they liked our fallback policy for model variants, but they want guarantees on audit logs retention and on-prem performance numbers. SE team to follow up with benchmarks.

[15:20] (crowd noise) Speaker 1: can we see the benchmarks?

[15:35] Priya Kaur: yes we'll share the benchmark sheet; also planning a 'private performance' playbook. link will be shared in the #all-hands channel after call.

[16:10] Anita Rao: hiring & org design — we are experimenting with a small product pod model for infra and billing to reduce cross-team dependencies. details in the doc. the aim is to speed up Dedicated feature work without adding bureaucracy.

[17:30] Miguel Santos: a couple of deeper tech notes — kernel selection improvements are working but we need better observability around sequence length distributions. Ops will add a per-route histogram to the console. that should help tuning.

[19:00] Eli Wong: reliability update — uptime has been 99.92% this quarter, a slip during March 3rd event cost us ~45 minutes of degraded streaming. postmortem is done, fix is multi-phased: better health checks, failover priority tuning and cache eviction improvements.

[20:35] Anita Rao: on metrics — product-led metrics to watch: DAUs for chat routes, cost per 1k tokens served, and conversion from free to paid. marketing/ops let's align on dashboards.

[22:00] Samir Patel: pricing experiment — we're piloting a burst pricing model for Dedicated customers who want queued burst capacity. finance will share assumptions and expected revenue uplift.

[23:45] Anita Rao: question about sales — are we losing deals to 'managed' providers that do full SRE for customers?

[24:05] Head of Sales (via chat): some customers prefer managed SRE; our pitch is that Dedicated + Redwood Console gives teams the tools to operate without hiring a huge infra team. we need more case studies.

[25:30] Priya Kaur: on telemetry and observability — Console improvements coming: per-route token breakdown, rollback hooks, and easier eval integration. this should address 'black box' concerns from customers.

[27:10] (hand raise) Employee: any update on regional expansion / APAC infra?

[27:30] Anita Rao: yes, APAC region pilot is scheduled for Q3; partnership and compliance checks ongoing. latency testing with local partners is in flight.

[28:45] Miguel Santos: small but annoying thing — we've had a few complaints about the SDK generics where function calling examples render incorrectly. docs is pushing a patch later this week. apologies for the friction.

[30:00] Anita Rao: quick culture note — thank you to the folks who put on the onboarding revamp, retention of new hires in first 90 days improved in our metric. also new learning stipend program going live next month.

[31:20] Eli Wong: infra roadmap ask — we want product folks to prioritize a consistent model pinning API; customers need deterministic rollouts across envs. proposal in the roadmap doc.

[33:00] (brief silence, typing)

[33:40] Anita Rao: ok let's move to Q&A — please keep questions short, we have about 20 minutes.

[34:10] Employee 1: curious about Dedicated pricing — any plan to make metered bursts cheaper for startups?

[34:35] Samir Patel: yes, there's a startup program being scoped; likely discounts for early usage and a simplified contract. details by mid april.

[35:20] Employee 2: what's the timeline for Private on-prem? a customer needs air-gapped deployment numbers.

[35:40] Priya Kaur: on-prem pilot is scheduled for late Q2; we have a partner talk next week to finalize packaging and HSM/KMS integration details. we will aim to provide a runbook and perf matrix.

[36:50] Employee 3: any update on community/open-source work and model cataloging?

[37:10] Miguel Santos: model catalog curation is ongoing; we're adding verification metadata for each model (quantization profile, expected latency, tested sequence lengths). community contributions welcomed but review is required.

[38:30] Anita Rao: ok, bit of future vision — our thesis remains that serving is the moat: predictable latency, cost controls, tooling. Q2 focus is to make those levers easy for customers to use.

[39:45] (crosstalk) Employee 4: can we get more clarity on the 'serving is the moat' marketing?

[40:05] Head of Marketing (via chat): yes we'll publish a short narrative and benchmark blog post in May aligning GTM with tech differentiators.

[41:20] Anita Rao: hiring ask again — managers please check open reqs and push urgency on senior infra + security engineers.

[42:05] (longer pause)

[42:30] Employee 5: regarding SOC 2, will there be an internal audit window?

[42:50] Security Lead: yes we'll have a two-week internal audit prep window starting 2026-04-06; expect action items in the compliance channel.

[44:00] Anita Rao: ok last section — org wins and shoutouts. we hit a big retention milestone in product, and the SE team closed a major retail POC. huge thanks.

[45:10] Priya Kaur: shoutout to the docs team for the SDK v0.9.7 rollback fix and to the infra team for the kernel selector rollout.

[46:30] Eli Wong: also a thanks to on-call rotations; the March 3rd incident was rough but the team's response meant limited customer impact overall.

[47:50] Anita Rao: wrapping up — recap of action items and next steps.

[48:10] Anita Rao: recap: 1) Security to finish SOC 2 evidence gaps by 2026-04-10, 2) Product to publish Dedicated 2.0 rollout doc by 2026-04-02, 3) Finance to finalize burst pricing assumptions by 2026-04-09, 4) Hiring leads to prioritize senior infra/security roles and post update by 2026-04-02.

[49:20] (typing) Employee 6: are there any customer testimonials we can use for Dedicated?

[49:35] Head of Sales: yes we'll collect two early adopter quotes and a short case study; SEs to coordinate.

[50:10] Anita Rao: final notes — we'll post the recording and slide deck in the #all-hands channel. thanks everyone.

[50:35] (applause emojis in chat)

[51:00] Q&A continues in chat; informal follow-ups and region-specific breakouts set up after this recording.
